adaptation.definition: The finished state of living comfortably in a new culture, when the local way no longer feels strange.
adaptation.example: After a year, adaptation: I queue without thinking about it now.

cs_professional_face.definition: The public standing a person carries at work: the regard of colleagues, clients and the team.
cs_professional_face.example: His professional face was in pieces for a month after the review.

grown_up.definition: An adult who looks after children, like a parent, a teacher or the school nurse.
grown_up.example: I told a grown-up about it.

kpar_knowledge.definition: What a person has when they can recall facts, use them to answer a question, and say why they hold.
kpar_knowledge.example: He had the facts and the knowledge, because he could say why the pump behaved that way.

mt_peer_timing.definition: The timing of the people around you, used as a reference point for your own.
mt_peer_timing.example: Peer timing says everybody my age is married; peer timing is not a measurement of me.

pump_earth_conductor.definition: The green-and-yellow wire that connects the metal parts of an installation to the earth.
pump_earth_conductor.example: The earth conductor was cut by a drill during the renovation.
